summary.text: Thomas Bergerson is the Republican candidate for Minnesota House of Representatives District 45B in the November 3, 2026 general election, running against Democratic incumbent Patty Acomb.
An author, he describes himself as a Minnesota citizen seeking to restore balance to state government.

paragraphs.text: Thomas Bergerson earned a high school diploma from The Blake School, a bachelor's degree from Colgate University in 1988 and a law degree from the University of Minnesota Law School in 1993.
His career experience includes working as an author.
In a Ballotpedia survey, Bergerson said his priorities include stopping fraud involving state taxpayer funds, restoring affordability and improving education.
He named energy as a personal policy interest and said approaches should balance affordability, reliability and environmental concerns.
